scope: EXPERIMENTAL / HARDWARE-INDEPENDENT / NOT ACTIVE PRODUCTION FIRMWARE
manifest_self_hash_note: Self-entry is intentionally unhashed to avoid recursive hashing; its content is covered by the enclosing Git commit.

cryptographic_backend.purpose: Isolated hardware-independent v4 core; not selected by production firmware
cryptographic_backend.license_choice: MIT (upstream offers Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT)
cryptographic_backend.backend: portable C/FIPS202, default stack, PCT enabled, no native assembly; MIT selected

hybrid_combiner.construction: NIST SP 800-56C Rev.2 section 4.1 option 1, SHA3-256, one 256-bit output block; hybrid Z-prime and SP 800-227 sections 4.6.2/4.6.3 equations 14/15
hybrid_combiner.root: SHA3-256(BE32(1) || ECDH32 || MLKEM32 || ASCII(protogen/v4/hybrid/p256-mlkem1024/sha3-256,NUL) || BE32(256) || BE32(length(T)) || T)
hybrid_combiner.key_expansion: HKDF-SHA-256(root, salt=transcript_hash, unique ASCII protogen/v4/ labels without NUL)
hybrid_combiner.claim_limits: Conditional one-surviving-secret protection under entropy, independence, KDF/hash, CSPRNG and endpoint/erasure assumptions; no blanket generic IND-CCA proof for arbitrary broken components, no FIPS 140 module certification.

validation.asan_ubsan: PASS; new core, native implementation and tests instrumented; not every third-party PSA path instrumented

validation.fresh_adversarial_review: Manual implementation review plus targeted tests and Clang Static Analyzer; optional security-diff-scan service unavailable, no independent certification claimed
